definitions.coverage: Soft foreground area divided by analytic circular body area, NOT all-image alpha area.
definitions.centroid: Alpha-weighted (SVG) or edge-background-difference weighted (legacy), body pixel coordinates.
definitions.contrast_centroid: Actual exported pixel contrast against inferred background, auxiliary optical cue.
definitions.36px: Full circular icon body reduced to 36px (default 300px canvas at60px has180px body at36px).
definitions.limitations: SVG alpha is exact geometry without collection shadows but not perceived optical weight. Legacy extraction is heuristic. Flags/full-bleed/low-confidence rows must not drive automatic normalization. Preserve shape-specific optical correction.
